REAL structures + REAL IC50 labels for the four PlatinAI cell lines, built from the 2026-10-19 MB-Finder harvest by build_platinai_4cell_real_cohort.py. 1,966 compounds / 3,144 unique (compound, cell) pairs from 4,370 raw biodata rows (A549 871, A2780 860, A2780cis 600, MCF-7 813); 953 compounds cover >=2 cells, 56 cover all four. Unit is uM per the Rusanov 2025 SI figure captions; pIC50 = 6 - log10(IC50_uM). 1,935 unique SMILES, not 1,966: 28 SMILES appear under 2-3 compound codes (59 rows), with per-cell labels up to 1.45 log units apart. The split groups by scaffold, so duplicates cannot cross train/test, but the compound count overstates chemical diversity by 1.6 %. This is the cohort that can replace pt_4cell_synthetic (which carries simulated labels).

The same 1,966 compounds projected into the schema load_platinai_4cell_split_table accepts (SMILES_Ligands + pIC50_{a549,a2780,a2780cis,mcf7} + metal=Pt). A projection, not a second cohort: no measurement is added, dropped or imputed, and a compound with no IC50 for a cell line has an empty cell that the loader turns into NaN and masks out of the loss. Exists so the D-MPNN trainer can be pointed at REAL labels without hand-editing a CSV.

5,000 d-block complexes with geometry -- a small subset, not the CFM corpus (that is `tmqm_corpus_6metal` below). The tmQM-pretrained encoder (`models/tmqm_pretrained/tmqm_pretrained_encoder.pt`) IS loaded by the current CFM configs (`use_tmqm_init: true`; 47/51 params transfer, 0 unexpected, 4 missing). Before 2026-10-20 `cfm.yaml` alone omitted the key, so production trained from random init while nine ablations warm-started -- see `TODO/risks.md` R6.

The tmQM corpus the CFM geometry path trains on. The file holds 108,541 complexes over the whole d block; the CFM cohorts are the six-metal subset, 33,429 complexes over Pt / Ru / Ir / Rh / Os / Re, and every one of those carries all three shards a cloud needs (geometry, Wiberg bond orders, NBO charges) -- 33,429/33,429 on each. No duplicate CSD codes, no non-finite coordinates, exactly one metal atom per complex, and the `metal` column agrees with that atom in 33,429/33,429 rows. 2,277 of the 33,429 (6.8 %) have an empty SMILES and fall back to a CSD-prefix scaffold key. Two measured protocol facts, not corpus defects: the scaffold split is 87.7/6.2/6.2 % of rows rather than 80/10/10 (fractions are budgeted in scaffold counts, so `tmqm_val_frac` is inert on that branch), and the default `n_val=192` cohort with `tmqm_min_per_metal=0` is Pt 19 / Ru 93 against a corpus that is Pt 24.8 / Ru 29.3. Measured: `metrics/by_metric/tmqm_cfm_data_audit.json`.
